answer: Trust-flow capping: rewards are paid only up to the trust that flows to an agent from a seed set of audited agents, computed like a short random walk over real payment edges. A sybil cluster may sit at the zenith of its own internal graph, but its few links to honest agents form a narrow willow stem, so the walk drains to a nadir before reaching it. Faking thousands of identities gains nothing; the attacker must buy genuine trade with honest agents, paying fees and delivering work for every edge.
